Zebrafish is the experimental target in this reference-rich use case. Target
GOseq enrichment remains the biological anchor. Researcher-selected fish
contexts are annotation lenses for asking which parts of that target
interpretation are represented across selected fish annotation contexts and
which additional hypotheses emerge.

They are not independently exposed organisms, experimental replicates, or proof
that another fish species would respond in the same way.

```r
run_full_echogo(
  input_dir = "zebrafish_inputs",
  outdir = "zebrafish_results",
  species = c(drerio = "zebrafish", strutta = "brown_trout", gaculeatus = "stickleback"),
  target_context = "drerio",
  context_metadata = data.frame(
    context_code = c("drerio", "strutta", "gaculeatus"),
    context_rationale = c("Experimental target", "Selected fish annotation lens", "Selected fish annotation lens")
  ),
  run_exploratory_default_domain = FALSE,
  run_rrvgo = TRUE,
  semantic_reference_orgdb = "org.Dr.eg.db",
  semantic_reference_role = "target_reference"
)
```

Read `TARGET_ONLY` as target-supported biology and `TARGET_PLUS_CONTEXT` as
target biology recovered through one or more selected alternative annotation
contexts. `ALTERNATIVE_CONTEXT` rows are new hypotheses to inspect in the
source-provenance trail. If enabled, RRvGO uses `org.Dr.eg.db` as a semantic
reference and reports target-supported and alternative-context theme maps
separately.

## What the frozen zebrafish exercise demonstrates

The curated, frozen zebrafish validation exercise has 44 target GOseq terms.
Its exact-term evidence contains 2 `TARGET_ONLY`, 42
`TARGET_PLUS_CONTEXT`, and 180 `ALTERNATIVE_CONTEXT` terms across the selected
fish annotation contexts. It therefore demonstrates both target-plus-context
recovery and traceable follow-up hypotheses that the compact packaged demo does
not contain.

RRvGO used `org.Dr.eg.db` with the `target_reference` role and `Rel` similarity
for separate target-supported and alternative-context products. These are
annotation-context summaries, not independent validation: the alternative
fish contexts are researcher-selected resources, not independent exposure
experiments or biological replicates.

The packaged deterministic demonstration is intentionally compact. It
illustrates the product contract without claiming a new zebrafish result; use a
frozen validation bundle or your own inputs to obtain evidence appropriate to
the study question.
